items.description: S3 Arctic system with EO/IR gimbal

notes: Draft ROM and SOW submitted to Trenton on 2026-07-31 for Engineering Sprint. Demo planned June 24-26, 2026 in Ottawa. Arctic demo in Whitehorse Nov-Apr 2027. Customer seeking 120km range (1h 35min TOF) S3 with EO/IR gimbal for Joint Forces Command evaluation. BST owes background info on past S2 Arctic ops and Canadian company contacts.
